meta.name: wowerpoint
meta.description: Turn one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF. Use for "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides", or any request to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文档一键变成可爱风演示文稿 PDF
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要把报告或文档快速变成可分享的演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Turn a document into a cute presentation PDF
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often turn reports or documents into shareable presentations

howto.what: 把一份文档交给 NotebookLM 生成 kawaii 风格的幻灯片 PDF,默认存成源文件同名加 -slides 的 PDF;若配置了 WOWerpoint 服务,还会返回手机端分享链接。只做幻灯片,不做视频和播客。
howto.when: 当你说「wowerpoint 这个」「给某文件做套幻灯片」「把这份报告变成幻灯片」等,或要求把一份文档渲染成可分享的叙事幻灯片时触发。

say.note: 生成 kawaii 幻灯片 PDF
输出 q3-slides.pdf 并给分享链接

say.text: 用 kawaii 角色讲这份文档的故事
say.note: 作为生成提示词原样传入

howto.what_en: Turns one document into a kawaii NotebookLM slide-deck PDF, saved next to the source as <stem>-slides.pdf. If the WOWerpoint service is configured, it also returns a mobile share URL. Slide-decks only, not videos or podcasts.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "wowerpoint this", "make a deck about <file>", "turn this report into slides" and similar asks to render a single document as shareable narrative slides.

say_en.note: Writes q3-slides.pdf plus a share link

say_en.text: Use kawaii characters to tell this story
say_en.note: Passed through as the generation prompt
